Welcome new users to Egalitarian!

I would like to encourage everyone to contribute content and start discussions about how to help close the gap between the genders in our communities. Shelters to support, charities to support, and public figures who truly want this world to be as equal as humanly possible.

 

The rules of the subverse are simple

 

1. No hate of a specific gender or overly generalized false statements.

example: "I hate men. They always use women for sex. That's all they care about" or "I hate women. They only use men for money"

This is not helping further a discussion and thus will be removed. Although these statements may be true about an individual you know or have seen on Dr. Phil, they are certainly not true about all people of certain gender.

2. No Spamming

Bring content from varying sources. If 75% or more of your posts are from one source we will assume you have an agenda. You will be given a warning and be limited from posting

3. No racism.

Simple. Do not be a bigot. There are subs for that and this is not the place.

4. NO DOXING

Your comment or post will be deleted and you will be given a warning. You can repost with out the information if you want. If you continually try and post information about individuals or an individual you will be temperately banned or permanently banned if you are a repeat offender.
